slides.title: An AI ballad hit No. 1
body: "The Adult I Dreamed Of" hit **No. 1** on Melon's Top 100 for three straight days. Melon is one of Korea's major streaming platforms. Korea JoongAng Daily calls it the first song composed and sung entirely by AI to top it.

facts.text: The ballad "The Adult I Dreamed Of" ranked No. 1 on Melon's Top 100 for three consecutive days as of Sunday, becoming the first song composed and sung entirely by AI to top the chart, according to Korea JoongAng Daily.
Melon is one of Korea's major music streaming platforms.

The song is by AI musician Meomuru, created by the duo Glorywave, composers and producers Lee Yong-seok and Choi Seong-hyeok, who wrote the lyrics and shaped the direction, then used AI to create the arrangement, melody and vocals.
It held No. 1 against A2O Lite's "Neon" (2nd), Rescene's "With" (3rd) and ILLIT's "You're Under Arrest" (4th).
It first topped YouTube's daily trending music video chart on Sept. 2, reached No. 29 on Melon by Oct. 2 and the top three on Oct. 15.
Its popularity grew as people used it as background music for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

The duo has reportedly been unable to collect royalties because the track is not registered with the Korea Music Copyright Association; under current rules all AI-generated songs are ineligible for copyright registration.
In August the association announced criteria recognizing human contributions to AI-assisted music but later withdrew them over insufficient public consultation.

caption:
An AI-made ballad just spent three straight days at No. 1 on Korea's Melon chart, but its creators reportedly can't collect royalties.

Korea JoongAng Daily calls "The Adult I Dreamed Of" the first song composed and sung entirely by AI to top Melon, one of Korea's major streaming platforms. Humans wrote the lyrics and shaped the direction.

→ It grew as background music in Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
→ It is not registered with the Korea Music Copyright Association, which rules out AI-generated songs
→ The association withdrew its August criteria on human input in AI-assisted music

Should a hit song made with AI be able to earn royalties?

Source: Korea JoongAng Daily, "AI-generated ballad conquers Melon chart", Nov 15, 2026.
